plans.title: 1 Year Business Growth Plan
policy: Eligible for a refund request within 7 days of purchase, subject to:
If the onboarding/setup of the business profile has been completed, 25% of the paid amount is deducted as onboarding and service charges.
Payment gateway charges of 3% are deducted from the refund amount.
If the GST invoice for the payment has already been filed, the 18% GST amount is deducted as per compliance requirements.
Once a refund is approved, a confirmation email is sent and the amount reaches your account within 5–7 business days, depending on the bank and payment provider.
included: Google Business Profile optimisation with onboarding
Review replies with SEO keywords, AI posts and Google posts
Photo and video uploads to your Google profile
